A.span: जो बोधिसत्त्व इस प्रकार गम्भीर हो चुके हैं,
A.explanation: Incorrectly attributes 'profound' to the bodhisattva instead of the dharma or vehicle.

A.span: अनासक्त परमार्थ-यान (में स्थित) हैं, जिनके लिए
A.explanation: Incorrectly changes the referent; it is the ultimate vehicle itself in which skandhas do not exist, not the bodhisattva.

B.span: जो बोधिसत्त्व इस प्रकार गम्भीर हो चुके हैं,
B.explanation: Incorrectly attributes 'profound' to the bodhisattva instead of the dharma or vehicle.

A.explanation: Translates 'experiencing/enjoying the results of karma' as 'engaging in karma'.

B.explanation: Translates 'experiencing/enjoying the results of karma' as 'engaging in karma'.

B.span: आकाश की व्यापकता में स्थित होने
B.explanation: Misses the key question 'on what does space rest?', translating it as 'situated in all-pervasiveness'.

A.span: इसे अविनिवर्तनीयता की भविष्यवाणी जानना चाहिए
A.explanation: Changes the referent; the bodhisattva should be known as prophesied to be irreversible, not the event.

B.explanation: Inappropriately pluralizes the singular 'mass of fire' (agniskandha).

A.explanation: Translates 'the retreat of the sons of the Sugata' as 'declared by the sons of the Sugata'.
Mistranslates 'drod snyoms' (evaluating or taking the measure of) as 'lazy' (kusīda).

A.span: बुद्ध-पुत्रों, श्रावकों, प्रत्येकबुद्धों और देवों के,
A.explanation: By applying the genitive case, it incorrectly makes these beings possessors rather than entities born from Prajnaparamita themselves.
Omits the specific detail "ཆུ་ཆུན་" (water-fetching) that describes the maid servant.
Uses "दुःशील" (immoral person) instead of the abstract noun "दुःशीलता" (immorality).

B.explanation: Omits the word "धर्म" (chos) from the phrase "ཡོན་ཏན་ཆོས་ལྡན་" (endowed with the dharmas of qualities).
The source 'rnam par 'dren pas' (nāyakena) is singular, referring to the Buddha, not plural.

A.explanation: The Tibetan "sems can dag pa" translates to "pure beings," not "the purity of beings."
